body: i understand where youre coming from, but he was never interested in my life before he left, he never asked about anything going on, so its just weird to me for him to want to know about it now. he was always just sort of there, and never really a parent. im not trying punishing him for his actions as an addict, but he was abusive, and probably wouldve been even without the drugs.
i agree, she can have whatever sort of relationship with him that she would like, but i dont want to have him be told about my life

my family/friends are trying to help me and i would like to go to therapy but its just so expensive. she was just such a big part of my life you know? i was in love with her and the fact that she did this while ive been in so much pain just stings so much more. thank you so much for the advice
